goodToKnow: Lauthals means at the top of one's voice or loudly: lauthals lachen, singen, protestieren, schimpfen. It's an adverb and can't go before nouns. From laut (loud) and der Hals (throat). Similar vivid expressions: aus vollem Hals(e) schreien, aus voller Kehle singen. The opposite is leise or im Flüsterton.
